derivation: The vendor header defines ASIC_TYPE=1387 and ASIC_CORE_NUM=114. The receive path maps raw codes0..56 directly and codes64..127 by subtracting7. Inverting that map for the114 counted positions gives0..56 and64..120. The vendor receive nonce word has a different byte order from the Braiins header representation.
limits: This is a source-derived map, not measured evidence for an exact silicon stepping or board.
The source archive selects T9_18; its header also contains S9_63. A shared ASIC definition does not establish whole-board compatibility.
The vendor receive code does not reject every unused raw code. The map uses only its114 counted core positions.
